slides.headline: Spain votes Sunday. A far-right party may decide it
slides.subline: **Here is what is at stake** in the general election.

slides.body: Spaniards vote in a **general election on Sunday**. PM Pedro Sánchez made his last pitch on Friday: [["vote, vote, vote"]] so Spain doesn't go "backwards".
Opinion polls point to **a change of government**. The conservative People's Party is slated to finish first, ending Sánchez's [[eight years]] in power.
The PP may need the **far-right Vox party** to govern. Reuters says Vox leader Abascal [[nears power]] as kingmaker. A hung parliament is also possible.
Voters are angry about **the cost of living** and rents so high many [[can't leave home]]. It also **kicks off a round of elections** across Europe.
Is the housing crisis the issue that should decide elections? Tell us below.
